'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Peter Jacobson LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Jacobson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Inventory wrongly DS; sheet LS We Have A Plan / Dazed and Confused.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Peter Jacobson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)|We Have A Plan (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
